feedback.Physical Object: Included — A discrete, tangible appliance with bounded structure.
feedback.Synthetic: Included — Fully designed and manufactured using industrial processes.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — Not modeled on biological systems.
feedback.Structural: Included — Defined by fixed internal chambers, tubes, and casing.
feedback.Observable: Included — Visible and commonly placed in kitchens or cafés.
feedback.Physical Medium: Included — Made of metal, plastic, circuitry, and thermal components.
feedback.Active: Included — Heats, pumps, and dispenses liquids dynamically.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Engineered specifically to automate coffee brewing.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Included — Produces hot liquid coffee, heat, and sometimes steam.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Included — Interprets input from users, timers, or sensors.
feedback.State-Transforming: Included — Transitions through brewing states: heating, dispensing, idle.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Included — Designed for user input (buttons, levers, apps).
feedback.System-integrated: Included — May be part of smart kitchen or IoT automation systems.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Included — Operates without active input once configured (e.g., start timer).
feedback.System-Essential: Excluded — Can be replaced or removed without breaking broader systems.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Uses sounds, lights, and displays to convey state and prompts.
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Executes programmed sequences and brewing logic.
feedback.Compositional: Excluded — Though it has parts, they do not form an abstract compositional system.
feedback.Normative: Excluded — Does not prescribe human values or social behavior.
feedback.Meta: Excluded — Does not represent itself or manage its own conceptual structure.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Brewing cycles, auto-starts, and warming periods are time-based.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Governed by embedded software, timers, and logic circuits.
feedback.Social Construct: Excluded — Defined materially and functionally, not symbolically.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Excluded — Not defined by formal institutions.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not inherently tied to identity or role.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Subject to appliance safety and food equipment standards.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Major global product category with extensive supply chains.
feedback.Politicised: Excluded — Not subject to major ideological debate.
feedback.Ritualised: Included — Central to habitual, cultural, and social practices (e.g., morning coffee).
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Raises issues of sustainability, energy use, and coffee sourcing.

encoding_notes: This encoding captures the coffee machine as an autonomous, digitally controlled appliance with ethical, economic, and ritual dimensions. It spans all four UHT layers, reflecting its deep integration into modern life. Final UHT code: DFFE631B.
